verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a documentation site generator, so a built-in MCP server for published sites is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence pack has no MCP server capability: Docusaurus builds static HTML, and its plugin architecture is only a developer building block. The probes also show no machine-readable endpoints (llms.txt, docs.md and OpenAPI all return 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my published docs site exposes its own MCP server that my users' agents can query for search and page content
